intro: The policies that keep the club safe, fair and well run. Each one is summarised in plain English below — the full document can be downloaded where available. Summaries are a guide only; the full policy is always the authority.

policies.title: Child Safeguarding Statement
policies.summary: How we keep children safe at the club.
points: Every coach and volunteer working with underage players is Garda vetted and completes GAA safeguarding training.
A Children's Officer (Celine Casey) is the first point of contact for any concern.
A risk assessment of club activities is carried out and reviewed regularly, and the statement is displayed in the clubhouse.
Summary to be reviewed by the committee — full text will be uploaded here.

policies.title: Code of Conduct — Players, Parents & Coaches
policies.summary: The standards we expect on and off the pitch.
points: Respect for teammates, opponents, referees and volunteers at all times.
Parents support positively from the sideline; coaches lead by example.
Breaches are handled by the committee through a fair, agreed process.
Summary to be reviewed by the committee — full text will be uploaded here.

policies.title: GDPR & Data Protection
policies.summary: How we handle members' personal information.
points: Member data is collected only for club administration, registration and insurance.
Photos of juveniles are used only with consent given at registration.
Data is never sold or shared beyond the GAA/LGFA systems required to run the club.
Summary to be reviewed by the committee — full text will be uploaded here.

policies.title: Health & Safety
policies.summary: Keeping the grounds and activities safe for everyone.
points: Pitches, equipment and the clubhouse are inspected and maintained on a schedule.
First-aid equipment and a defibrillator are available on site.
Incidents are recorded and reviewed by the committee.
Summary to be reviewed by the committee — full text will be uploaded here.

policies.title: Social Media Policy
policies.summary: How the club and its members use social media responsibly.
points: Official channels are run by the PRO/communications team.
No photos or names of juveniles without registration consent.
Members representing the club online do so with the same respect expected on the pitch.
